name: Pratt Woodworks
old_description: At Pratt Woodworks, we source our lumber from local mills and woodcutters who focus their business on milling trees that have fallen naturally or been removed with purpose. Our goal is to preserve the integrity of the wood and create beautiful, sustainable pieces that last for generations. Only the highest qualities of natural hardwoods are used to create your one-of-a-kind piece of furniture.
about:
Pratt Woodworks operates from Greenville, South Carolina. The company was established to craft custom furniture using lumber sourced from local mills and woodcutters who specialize in milling trees that have fallen naturally or been removed with purpose. While the founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, the business centers on a supply chain that prioritizes wood with a natural or purposeful origin.

The workshop produces one-of-a-kind pieces, selecting only the highest qualities of natural hardwoods. Its process emphasizes preserving the integrity of the wood from sourcing through final assembly, resulting in furniture designed to last for generations. Each piece is built to order, with attention to grain character and structural soundness, though specific production volumes, facility size, and headcount are not published.

The company serves customers seeking sustainable, handcrafted furniture for residential and commercial settings. Pratt Woodworks says its approach sets it apart by combining local sourcing with a focus on material integrity and long-term durability, aiming to create beautiful, enduring pieces that honor the natural life of each tree.
